card.name: Words leading into a future end date
card.fires_on: Words just before a future time span or end year, such as 'through', 'at least', 'next', 'stand' or 'repeat again until'. The setting is a statement about how long something will last or when it will next happen.

modes.label: Lead-in to an end year
modes.description: Words like 'through' or 'at least' right before a future year.
modes.example: about 12% job growth for K-12 teachers<< through>> 2016 – a pace

modes.label: Duration of lasting
modes.description: Verbs about something enduring or not recurring, before a length of time.
modes.example: the policy that Justice O'Conner predicted would<< stand>> for 25 years from her opinion

modes.label: Next period
modes.description: The word 'next' before a span such as a century or two years.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a text is about to say how far into the future something will last.
